budget.label: Cramped
budget.tradeoff: Cheap and light, but the crew will be grumpy.

standard.label: Standard
standard.tradeoff: A fair home for three astronauts.

premium.label: Roomy
premium.tradeoff: Happy crew, but you pay for every extra tonne.

budget.label: Budget
budget.tradeoff: Cheap air. One in four chance of trouble in flight.

standard.label: Standard
standard.tradeoff: Clean air and a small chance of hiccups.

premium.label: Premium
premium.tradeoff: Almost never fails, but it is heavy and power-hungry.

budget.label: Budget
budget.tradeoff: Simple and light. Not much juice to spare.

standard.label: Standard
standard.tradeoff: Enough power for a normal capsule.

premium.label: Premium
premium.tradeoff: Lots of power, lots of weight.

shady.label: Used Battery Pack
shady.tradeoff: Premium power at a bargain price. Barely used. Probably.

budget.label: Budget
budget.tradeoff: A basic radio. Mission Control hears less from you.

standard.label: Standard
standard.tradeoff: A clear line to the ground.

premium.label: Premium
premium.tradeoff: Crystal clear, but it drinks more power.

shady.label: Surplus Radio
shady.tradeoff: Fell off a truck. A very nice truck.

budget.label: Budget
budget.tradeoff: Cheap brain. More chances for a software bug.

standard.label: Standard
standard.tradeoff: Tested software that does its job.

premium.label: Premium
premium.tradeoff: Backup computers that check each other's math.

shady.label: Refurbished Flight Computer
shady.tradeoff: Premium brain, half the price. Only rebooted twice today.
